A '''traffic controller''' was an individual in charge of directing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] through landing instruction on ground facilities and inside [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]]. 

==Description==
Traffic controllers were responsible for directing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and air vehicles through a control zone, guiding them to and from their appointed landing berths. They were usually posted in observation towers, overseeing facilities as diverse as orbital docking platforms all the way down to simple landing strips. For organic beings, the job can be stressful but monotonous. As a result, [[Controller droid/Legends|controller droids]] were developed.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Expert traffic controllers were able to coordinate starfighter launches faster than automated launch systems.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Traffic Control}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:RedemptionHangar-SW1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A traffic controller directs three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] landing aboard the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']]]]
During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], traffic controllers directed the launch of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]] from inside the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="ANH" />

When [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Silam Dunerz]] laid a [[Skirmish aboard the Redemption|trap]] to capture [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on her way back from [[Morton (planet)|Morton]], he landed his [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] with the guidance of a traffic controller.<ref name="LT">{{SWComicCite|7.12|Leia's Trust}}</ref>

Shortly after the [[Mission to Dominus III|mission]] to [[Dominus III]], a traffic controller directed the simultaneous arrival of three X-wing starfighters from [[Scout Group]] aboard the ''Redemption''.<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref>

The former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mako Spince]] held this profession while on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="DE3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref>
